test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of following is in-house software of the Indian Railways to tackle the problem of cattle getting run over by the trains?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smart Event Tracking System.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Smart Event Tracking System (SETS):**

 
 
• The **Ministry of Railways' in-house programme **is called Smart Event Tracking System (SETS).
 
• **A new planning and analysis tool based on Google Maps has been implemented to address the issue of cattle being run over by trains.**
 
• The Agra Division has put the programme into use, and other divisions will eventually adopt it.
 
• Of the 26,000 occurrences of cattle ran over reported in 2020–21, over 6,500 occurred on the North Central Railway, which is situated in Prayagraj.
 
• Parts of the Delhi-Howrah and Delhi-Mumbai routes are also located in this zone.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Real Time Train Information System (RTIS):**

 
 
• It was** created in partnership with the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO),** is being installed on trains **to automatically acquire their "movement timing at the stations, including that of arrival and departure or run-through."**
 
• It will provides mid-section updates with a periodicity of 30 seconds. Without requiring any manual assistance, the Train Control can keep a closer eye on the whereabouts and velocity of trains equipped with RTIS.
 
• For the purpose of tracking train movements, the RTIS **employs data from GSAT satellites equipped with GAGAN payloads.**
 
• The data is then transmitted to the Centre for Railway Information Systems' Central Location Server (CLS) (CRIS).
